# Fund III — SCP's Active Investing Vehicle

- **What it is:** **Stonehaven Capital Partners Fund III**, the firm's current fund. **$850M**,
  **2023 vintage**.
- **Deployment:** ~**55% deployed**. Live deals [Onyx](onyx.md) and [Halberd](halberd.md) would
  draw further; [Cedar Point Logistics](cedar-point-logistics.md) is a potential add.
- **Performance (net, Q2 2026):** **net IRR ~18%**, **DPI ~0.3x**, **TVPI ~1.4x** — early in the
  fund's life, mostly unrealized.
- **Governance:** IC chaired by [William Stonehaven](../people/william-stonehaven.md); finance by
  CFO [Laura Mendes](../people/laura-mendes.md); LPs by
  [Tom Restrepo](../people/tom-restrepo.md).
- **Anchor LP:** [Harold Weiss](../people/harold-weiss.md) (state pension) — largest commitment;
  note his **defense-sector exclusion** before routing any deal near him.
